parts.t: Welcome to Hazelmere — a peaceful
South Surrey

neighbourhood known for its acreage properties, hobby farms and farmland in the Agricultural Land Reserve. Browse all Hazelmere real estate listings updated daily. If you're buying or selling in Hazelmere, South Surrey REALTOR® Jared Gibbons can walk you through recent sales and what to check on a property.
Neighbourhood Summary · South Surrey

Hazelmere is the rural south-east corner of South Surrey, around 16 Avenue and 184 Street and running south toward 0 Avenue and the US border. The City of Surrey uses the name on its heritage pages, and long-time locals may also know the district as Hall's Prairie. Homes here are mostly
acreages
and large rural lots under agricultural zoning. That means the ALR, well and septic checks matter as much as the house itself.
Local Guide · Hazelmere Valley & Hall's Prairie
Hazelmere feels like the countryside, even though it is only a few minutes from Highway 15 and the shops of
Grandview Heights
. The Little Campbell River and its tributaries, including Jacobsen Creek, wind through the area. Campbell Valley Regional Park, a Metro Vancouver park in Langley Township, lies just to the east.

The City does not publish a single boundary map for Hazelmere. City documents place it around 16 Avenue and 184 Street, with the Hazelmere Valley reaching south to 0 Avenue near 184 Street. To the north is the South Campbell Heights plan area, which the City has set aside mainly for employment land.
Access & Transit

blocks.text: Roads and getting around 16 Ave, 8 Ave, 0 Ave & Hwy 15

parts.t: The main roads are 16 Avenue, 8 Avenue, 0 Avenue, 184 Street and 192 Street, with Highway 15 (176 Street) to the west and Highway 99 further west via 16 Avenue. No TransLink bus route was confirmed on 8 Avenue, 0 Avenue or 184 Street. The nearest confirmed route is the 531, which runs along 24 Avenue and 192 Street between White Rock Centre and Willowbrook.
Catchments · SD36

The public school inside Hazelmere is Xwʼepiteng Elementary at 18035 8 Avenue, formerly Hall's Prairie Elementary. Its name was gifted by Semiahmoo First Nation. East Kensington Elementary nearby is a district choice school, not a neighbourhood catchment school. Catchment depends on the exact address, so check the Surrey Schools School Locator. On the Surrey Schools boundary map, Hazelmere sits inside the Douglas Elementary catchment; the Xwʼepiteng site is a program school. For secondary, most of Hazelmere is Earl Marriott Secondary. The district's boundary map and its Families of Schools list don't line up for the strip from about 17 to 20 Avenue, so check the School Locator for those addresses.
Golf & Rec

blocks.text: Parks and recreation Hazelmere Golf & Tennis Club

parts.t: Hazelmere Golf & Tennis Club is at 18150 8 Avenue. There is no City recreation centre or library branch inside Hazelmere. Most families use the Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre, the South Surrey Recreation & Arts Centre and the Semiahmoo or Ocean Park libraries.
Errands
There is no shopping centre or grocery store inside Hazelmere. For errands, most people drive west to Morgan Crossing in Grandview Heights or to the Grandview Heights shopping area.
Bylaw 12000 · Part 10

blocks.text: Zoning: what an acreage allows A-1 General Agriculture & RA rules

parts.t: A City planning report confirms A-1 General Agriculture zoning for Hazelmere Valley acreages. Under Part 10 of Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000, the minimum lot area for a new A-1 subdivision is 4 hectares inside the ALR and 2 hectares outside it. The A-1 zone allows one single-family dwelling, which may contain one secondary suite. A separate coach house on an A-1 or ALR acreage is not confirmed on a City source, so ask the City and check the Agricultural Land Commission's rules before you count on one. Some nearby land is zoned RA Acreage Residential, where Surrey's minimum lot size is 4,050 m². My
South Surrey lots and land
page covers vacant land checks too.
Rural Checks

blocks.text: ALR, wells and septic ALC Map Finder, GWELLS & setbacks

parts.t: Parts of Hazelmere are in the ALR, and some properties are only partly inside it. Always check the specific parcel in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR map finder. Rural homes may use private wells and onsite septic. Look up any well record in the Province's GWELLS system, and read the Province's property-owner guidance on wells and septic before buying. Streams such as the Little Campbell River and Jacobsen Creek can bring streamside setbacks, so check those with the City too. If farming is the plan, my
South Surrey farms
page goes into the farm zones and ALR rules.
Planning & Roads

blocks.text: Plans and projects South Campbell Heights & road upgrades

parts.t: The South Campbell Heights Plan covers the Little Campbell River area north of Hazelmere's southern lands and adds employment land next to Campbell Heights. The City also lists phased road improvements on 192 Street, 16 Avenue and other east–west roads. The golf-course lands at 0 Avenue and 184 Street have a long-running development application. Treat that as application-stage only, not an approved plan.

Common Questions · Hazelmere
Is Hazelmere in the ALR?
Parts are. City documents show ALR land in and around Hazelmere, including properties that are partly inside the reserve. Check the specific parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission's maps.
What is the smallest A-1 lot that can be created?
Part 10 of Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000 sets 4 hectares inside the ALR and 2 hectares outside it for new A-1 lots.
Which elementary school is in Hazelmere?

Xwʼepiteng Elementary at 18035 8 Avenue. Catchment for a specific address must be checked in the School Locator. Douglas Elementary, then usually Earl Marriott Secondary. For homes between about 17 and 20 Avenue, check the School Locator.
Is there bus service on 8 Avenue or 184 Street?
No TransLink route on those roads was confirmed. The nearest is the 531 on 24 Avenue and 192 Street.
Are homes on well and septic?
Many rural acreages are. Check GWELLS for a well record and get the septic system inspected by an Authorized Person before you buy.
Can an acreage add a coach house?
A secondary suite inside the main house is allowed under the A-1 zone. A separate coach house on A-1 or ALR land is not confirmed, so confirm with the City and the Agricultural Land Commission first.
Where does the name Hazelmere come from?
Henry T. Thrift chose it to promote settlement around his land near 16 Avenue and 184 Street, according to Surrey's place-name history.
